name: fetch_world_bank_indicator
description: Fetches the latest available World Bank indicator value for a country (ISO2/ISO3 code or name resolved to code).

manifest.name: fetch_world_bank_indicator
manifest.description: Fetches the latest available World Bank indicator value for a country (ISO2/ISO3 code or name resolved to code).
manifest.notes: api.worldbank.org/v2/country?format=json&per_page=400 lists 296 entries (id=ISO3, iso2Code, name); index 1 of the response holds rows. /v2/country/{code}/indicator/{ind}?format=json&mrnev=1 returns the most recent non-empty value: [meta,[{indicator:{id,value},country:{id,value},countryiso3code,date,value}]]. Country id is ISO3 (IN resolves to IND). Invalid country or indicator returns HTTP 200 with [{message:[{id:120,...}]}].

files.test_impl.py:
import pytest
from impl import run


def test_example():
    r = run({'country': 'IN', 'indicator': 'SP.POP.TOTL'})
    assert r['country'] == 'IND'
    assert r['country_name'] == 'India'
    assert r['indicator'] == 'SP.POP.TOTL'
    assert r['value'] > 1e9
    assert r['year'].isdigit()


def test_name_resolution():
    r = run({'country': 'India', 'indicator': 'SP.POP.TOTL'})
    assert r['country'] == 'IND'


def test_bad_country():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({'country': 'Notarealplace', 'indicator': 'SP.POP.TOTL'})


def test_bad_indicator():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({'country': 'IN', 'indicator': 'BAD.XXX'})


def test_missing_country():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({'indicator': 'SP.POP.TOTL'})
